items.subject: THORESEN SHIPPING SINGAPORE - OPEN POSITIONS - PACIFIC & INDIAN OCEAN
items.snippet: /LILIAN THOR FAH 56K/2012 BLT SEMI-OHBS OPEN KOH SICHANG 23 APRIL TRY ANY PREFER PERIOD OR LONG TCT DUR ASKING 17K FOR MIN 5 / MAX 7 MOS GRAIN CLEAN MV THOR FAH SINGAPORE FLAG BLT 2012 SDBC/SEMI-OPEN
items.body_text:
/LILIAN

THOR FAH 56K/2012 BLT SEMI-OHBS
OPEN KOH SICHANG 23 APRIL

TRY ANY PREFER PERIOD OR LONG TCT DUR

ASKING 17K FOR MIN 5 / MAX 7 MOS

GRAIN CLEAN

MV THOR FAH
SINGAPORE FLAG BLT 2012
SDBC/SEMI-OPEN HATCH BOX SHAPE
56,104 SDWT ON 12.568 M TPC 57.39
5 HOLDS/5 HATCHES
GR/BL 64,634/64,064 CBM
GRD 4 X 30 MTC
GRAB 4 X 12 CBM
LOA/BM 189.99 / 32.26 M
GT/NT 31,804 / 16,746 INTERNATIONAL
PNI : WEST OF ENGLAND
CLASS: NKK

SPEED/CONS
AT SEA : B/L ABT 12.0/11.2 KTS ON ABT 18.2/21.5 MT VLFO
IN PORT : IDLE ABT 2.5 MT VLFO
WRKG ABT 4.5 MT VLFO + ABT 0.1 MT LMG

SPEED AND CONSUMPTION FIGURES ARE “ABOUT” WHICH IS APPLICABLE TO BOTH AND
JOINTLY TO SPEED AND CONSUMPTION (MEANING SPECIFICALLY 0.5 KTS FOR SPEED
AND 5% FOR CONSUMPTION), AND BOTH SPEED AND CONSUMPTION ARE ALWAYS
CALCULATED ONLY FROM BEGINNING SEA PASSAGE TO END SEA PASSAGE, EXCLUDING
ANY VOYAGE UP TO 36 HOURS DURATION, AND BOTH SPEED AND CONSUMPTION ARE
ALWAYS SUBJECT TO GOOD WEATHER CONDITIONS (24 CONSECUTIVE HOURS) OF UP TO
AND INCLUDING BEAUFORT SCALE 4 AND DOUGLAS SEA STATE 3, WITH COMBINED WAVE
AND SWELL HEIGHTS NOT TO EXCEED 1.25 M, WITHOUT ANY ADVERSE CURRENTS,
WITHOUT NEGATIVE INFLUENCE OF SWELL, BEING ON EVEN KEEL AND EXCLUDING
PERIODS DURING WHICH REDUCTIONS OF SPEED FOR SAFETY, REDUCED VISIBILITY,
STEAMING AND/OR MANEUVERING IN CONGESTED WATERS ETC. SPEED IS NOT TO BE
DEBITED DUE TO FAVOURABLE CURRENTS.

DAYS EXCEEDING THE AGREED ABOVE MENTIONED GOOD WEATHER CONDITIONS ARE TO BE
EXPRESSLY EXCLUDED WHEN VESSEL’S SPEED EVALUATION IS CONDUCTED, NO OTHER
EXTRAPOLATION WILL BE ALLOWED. AN UNDERPERFORMANCE CLAIM CAN ONLY BE
SUBMITTED IN RESPECT OF DAYS (24 CONSECUTIVE HOURS) ON WHICH THE VESSEL
ENCOUNTERED WIND UP TO AND INCLUDING BEAUFORT SCALE 4 & DOUGLAS SEA STATE 3,
WITH COMBINED WAVE AND SWELL HEIGHTS NOT TO EXCEED 1.25 M, WITHOUT ANY
ADVERSE CURRENTS, WITHOUT NEGATIVE INFLUENCE OF SWELL. ALWAYS SUBJECT TO
GOOD QUALITY OF BUNKERS AS AGREED HEREIN.

THE VESSEL IS ALLOWED TO USE MDO/MGO WHEN MANEUVERING AND PASSING
NARROW / RESTRICTED / CONFINED WATER, INCLUDING WHEN THE VESSEL
CARRIES OUT HOLD CLEANING AND BILGE PUMPING.

BUNKERS IFO(380 CST) PARAMETERS AS PER ISO8217/2010
RMG 380 AND MDO AS PER ISO8217/2010 - DMB

IN THE EVENT THAT CHARTERERS ORDER THE VESSEL TO PORT(S) AND/OR AREA(S)
WHERE THE VESSEL'S STAY IS PROLONGED (I.E., 20 DAYS OR MORE IN TROPICAL
AND/OR SEASONAL TROPICAL ZONES AND/OR WATERS, IN PORT AND/OR AT BERTH
AND/OR AT ANCHORAGE AND/OR DRIFTING AND/OR ANY MOVEMENTS THAT ARE LESS
THAN 8 HOURS AT FULL SPEED, OR 25 DAYS OR MORE IN ANY OTHER WORLDWIDE
AREA OR LAY-UP), UNDERWATER CLEANING OF THE HULL, INCLUDING THE PROPELLER,
ETC., IS TO BE DONE AT THE FIRST WORKABLE OPPORTUNITY AND ALWAYS AT THE
CHARTERERS' TIME AND EXPENSE. IN CASE THE HULL IS FOULED DURING LADEN
CONDITION BUT UNDERWATER HULL CLEANING IS ARRANGED AT BALLAST CONDITION,
CHARTERERS ARE TO CLEAN ALL FOULED AREAS, INCLUDING THE AREA ABOVE THE
WATERLINE, ALWAYS AT THE CHARTERERS' TIME AND EXPENSE. THE CLEANING IS TO
BE DONE TO THE OWNERS' AND MASTER'S APPROVAL AND SATISFACTION, INCLUDING
THE USE OF CCTV, A CLASS-APPROVED CLEANING COMPANY, ENSURING NO DAMAGE TO
THE HULL PAINTING, AND CHARTERERS ARE TO PROVIDE A HULL CLEANING REPORT
WITH PHOTOS AND VIDEOS. THEREAFTER, THE VESSEL'S PERFORMANCE WARRANTIES
ARE TO BE REINSTATED.

ONCE IT IS APPROXIMATELY ESTIMATED THAT VESSEL’S STAY WILL MEET ANY OF
THE TWO AFOREMENTIONED PERIODS, OWNERS SHALL HAVE THE RIGHT TO CARRY OUT
8-HOURS FULL SPEED FOULING PREVENTION NAVIGATION WITHIN THE AREA,
AT CHARTERERS' TIME, EXPENSE AND ARRANGEMENTS, AND THIS RIGHT CAN BE
EXERCISED ANYTIME WITHIN OR AFTER THE 20/25 DAYS PERIOD STATED IN THIS
CLAUSE. FOR THE PURPOSES OF THIS CLAUSE, OWNERS’ ESTIMATE OF THE VESSEL’S
STAY IN THE AREA SHALL BE FINAL AND CONCLUSIVE. UPON COMPLETION OF
SUCCESSFUL ANTI-FOULING NAVIGATION, SPEED AND CONSUMPTION WARRANTIES TO
BE REINSTATED.

IN ANY CASE(S), UNDERWATER CLEANING OF HULL INCLUDING PROPELLER ETC,
MUST BE PERFORMED LATEST PRIOR VESSEL’S REDELIVERY OTHERWISE OWNERS
ARE ENTITLED TO ALL DAMAGES ARISING FROM CHARTERERS’ BREACH OF THE CP,
INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO HULL CLEANING, OFF-HIRE DURING CLEANING,
PORT EXPENSES, BUNKERS AND POTENTIAL UNDERPERFORMANCE AND
OVER-CONSUMPTION CLAIM FROM NEXT CHARTERERS.

OWNERS : THORESEN SHIPPING SINGAPORE PTE LTD.
MANAGERS: THORESEN & CO., (BANGKOK) LTD.
(ALL DETS ABT)

BEST REGARDS

Thanks and Best Regards

Lilian Li
SSY
